wars.name: Piedras Negras-Yaxchilan wars
wars.outcome: 727: 'the ruler was victorious over Yaxchilan ... capturing a sajal, as commemorated in Stela 8'; 808: Ruler 7 captured by Yaxchilan's K'inich Tatb'u Skull III and the dynasty effectively ended. The Yaxchilan page adds 460, 514, 759. No land change is dated.
wars.note: The Yaxchilan page dates the Piedras Negras victory to 726.

wars.name: Piedras Negras's wars on Palenque, Santa Elena and Pomona
wars.outcome: K'inich Yo'nal Ahk I 'defeated Palenque in AD 628, taking captive Ch'ok Balum'; 662 victory over Santa Elena (Stela 35); 725 'the capture of one of his sajal by Palenque'; 787 'the defeat of Santa Elena' and 'wars with Pomoná'. No land change is dated.

notes:
NEW STATE. Cliopatria has no Piedras Negras row. The gazetteer's 'Piedras Negras' is the Mexican city on the Rio Grande: do not use it; the dossier uses coordinates.
DATES AND DISCREPANCIES. The page's infobox says 'Built: c. 200 AD' and 'Classic-Postclassic' while the text says occupation began in the 7th century BC and the site was 'abandoned by AD 930' (ceramics show occupation to 850). 'The dynasty which had governed over Piedras Negras since AD 603' is a later dynasty; the earlier table runs from K'an Ahk II (ca 460) through Yat Ahk I (510-514) and Ruler C (514-53[3]). The start 460 is the first dated king of the table, not a founding. 514 is a Long Count conversion (9.4.0.0.0) by the researcher.
COORDINATES. Neither the page nor the Yaxchilan page prints them; (-91.26, 17.17) is the researcher's own knowledge, flagged here.
COUNTERPARTS. Santa Elena, Pomona (Pomoná), Lacanha have no dossiers.
